payload.text: **Build 0081 together with 0084; vc reviews** (hv's ruling, 2026-09-17, relayed by vc; recorded in both issues at bf13028). Both change lib/helpers. 0081: assert_identifier's list of devbin's own variables is stale. 0084 is shape A, write through the link: every writer resolves the path to the file it names and stages and renames beside that file, so the link survives and its target gets the edit; the bare VERSION recipe already follows a link and stays as it is; a dangling link is refused naming it; how the link is resolved wants measuring on both CI runners. vc's review probes: the clobber probe for 0081, and the symlink probe for 0084 (version set with linked version files, release notes with a linked CHANGELOG.md). Read both issues whole first; red-first and mutants as ever; tell vc before any full suite. Starts after the compact.
